# SK0206 — The empty string expression is not arranged

<!-- Generated from Rules/Rikarin.Skala.Rules.Metadata/rules.json. Do not edit. -->

`skala arrange` would use the configured empty-string spelling.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | Formatting |
| Default severity | suggestion |
| Scope | Semantic |
| Needs a compilation | yes |
| Fix | no |
| Language version floor | — |
| Since | 2.0 |

## Why

`skala_empty_string` chooses between the empty literal and `string.Empty`, and both values rewrite: `empty_literal` turns `string.Empty` into `""`, `string_empty` turns `""` (and `@""`) into `string.Empty`. Binding prevents a same-named member on another type from being mistaken for the framework field.

## Example

Instead of:

```csharp
var text = "";
```

Write:

```csharp
var text = string.Empty;
```

## When it does not fire

None relative to the effective configuration. Only the framework string type is recognised. Under `string_empty` every position that requires a constant is left alone, because `string.Empty` is not one: `const` declarations and their initializers, attribute arguments, default parameter values, `case` labels and `goto case`, and patterns. So are `$""`, `""u8` and any `""` inside an expression tree.

## Configuration

- `skala_empty_string`
